title: Decoder Evaluation and Adversarial-Risk Certification for Quantum Error-Correcting Memories: Reproduction Archive
description: SHA-256-anchored reproduction archive for the manuscript 'Decoder Evaluation and Adversarial-Risk Certification for Quantum Error-Correcting Memories'. Contains all primary CSVs (single-round, repeated-cycle, adaptive ladder, and the finite-size extension repeated_cycle_fss_*.csv), BB72/BB144/BB288 code parameters with the exact-distance certificate checker, the pinned paired decoder grid with failbit-level pairing evidence, the Kunlun released-DEM re-analysis, the corrected circuit-level arm (v24-corrected-extraction with protocol-invariance tests), IBM Quantum hardware campaign records including the pre-registered causal ablation executed 2026-10-11 (theory_test_causal/), the QEC Emulator v2.0.0 package source, manuscript sources (v17-manuscript/, current sn-jnl variant main2_refurbished.tex), a Dockerfile-pinned environment, and an archive-wide SHA-256 manifest (1821 files). Offline reproduction: cd qae_experiments && python reproduce_all.py --quick.
notes: Supersedes the v15/v16 archive records (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20588042): adds the finite-size scaling extension and the executed causal-ablation campaign.
